name: H2_PATCH1_DEV_A
ruling_2026-09-15_eighth: We should stop trying to make H2-discovered answer nodes win six whole partition slots. That is the wrong unit of repair ... The next experiment I would run is a query-local structure patch ... collect H2 nodes NOT already exposed by SAFE -> pack them into one query-local virtual block -> replace only the weakest SAFE block -> 49 static blocks + 1 H2 patch ... Freeze section 14.1's beam exactly. Start from canonical SAFE ... 1. union of nodes already exposed by SAFE's 50 selected blocks; 2. H2 visited nodes not already in that union; 3. order them by the already frozen H2 beam order; 4. at most one block's capacity -- the same number of nodes as the block being replaced; 5. remove the weakest selected SAFE block; 6. insert the query-local patch ... if H2 has only k < n_b novel nodes, don't quietly increase/decrease the budget: fill the remaining n_b - k positions from the removed block itself, so |served nodes_PATCH| = |served nodes_SAFE| exactly ... [ordering] take novel deepest-hop nodes first, then frozen within-hop beam order -- or even cleaner, simply PATCH = H2 nodes not already served in frozen beam order; if most hop-1 nodes disappear because they're already served, we may not need a depth rule at all. Inspect that before pre-registration, without using gold ... Compare SAFE vs SAFE+PATCH1 across all five DEV_A caches, exploratory only ... Primary observations: ALL-gold under matched unique-node exposure; MetaQA hop2; SQuAD/MuSiQue regression; gold nodes discovered by the patch; novel H2 nodes/query; fraction of patch occupied by H1 vs H2; removed-block gold-loss vs patch gold-gain. And one very important diagnostic: of the 98 MetaQA failures for which H2 currently has a complete repair somewhere in its candidate pool, how many become covered when those H2 nodes are packed together rather than represented by their owner blocks? ... Do not run: agreement scoring, fourth H2 channel, support-count admission, another F6 merge, new RRF constants ... Close block-level H2->SAFE admission experiments for now. Open exactly one new arm: H2_PATCH1.

frozen_and_reused_verbatim.canonical_SAFE: the frozen B6_S4_F6_Ms64_Mr32 selector through its own code (_l1ps_router.build_cache + _l1kb_core.contexts / f6_select); its recomputed indicator must equal the frozen replay records' _ind_SAFE on every DEV_A row (asserted, else the run is invalid)
frozen_and_reused_verbatim.H2_beam: the pinned MICRO_L3_H2 beam of scratchpad/_l1c_microl3.py (sha256 19774617f5841fb02471498ad2af29ba9098f32e11aec06831724d569c99e6c5, asserted): frozen 5 seeds, actual STRUCT adjacency under the frozen hub policy, depth exactly 2, beam 100 per hop, frozen transition geometry + RRF; identical beam output asserted by rebuilding section 14.1's MICRO_L3_H2 and matching its recorded BASE_ALL / gained / lost

the_arm_H2_PATCH1.1_start: canonical SAFE's final 50 blocks = served positions 0-43 (protected) u the six blocks admitted by the frozen F6 competition
the_arm_H2_PATCH1.2_weakest: the sixth block of the F6 competition order (SAFE's own weakest admission; ties already resolved by F6's rule); removed
the_arm_H2_PATCH1.3_kept: the other 49 blocks, served whole; exposed nodes = their node sets
the_arm_H2_PATCH1.4_novel: pinned-beam visited nodes (hop-1 beam then hop-2 beam in the frozen fused order; seeds excluded exactly as in the frozen vote) whose own block hard[v] is not among the 49 kept blocks -- visited nodes of the removed block therefore count as novel and keep their beam position
the_arm_H2_PATCH1.5_capacity: n_b = size of the removed block; patch = the first min(k, n_b) novel nodes in that order
the_arm_H2_PATCH1.6_fill: if k < n_b: the remaining n_b - k positions are the removed block's own nodes not already in the patch, in the frozen fused node-list order (ret_rrf position ascending for ranked nodes, then the rest by node id ascending) -- the budget is never increased or decreased
the_arm_H2_PATCH1.7_served: served nodes = nodes of the 49 kept blocks u patch; |served_PATCH| = |served_SAFE| exactly (asserted per query)
not_done: no second arm (deepest-first order, alternative fill order, other weakest rule, other capacity) -- 'exactly one new arm'
no agreement scoring / fourth channel / support-count admission / F6 merge / new RRF constants
no cap, threshold or constant chosen from DEV_A numbers
no change to the beam, seeds, depth, transition scoring or hub policy

arms.SAFE: canonical SAFE (the comparison baseline, per the ruling)
arms.H2_PATCH1: primary: SAFE with its weakest admitted block replaced by the matched-size query-local patch

metric: ALL-gold under matched unique-node exposure: every gold NODE of the query inside the served node set (for L1 and SAFE this equals the frozen block-level ALL-gold@P50 because gold blocks are exactly the blocks of the gold nodes -- asserted against ind_base and the frozen _ind_SAFE); ANY-gold reported; per hop on metaqa; exact two-sided McNemar on the paired indicator

decision_rule.text_safety_required: on each of squad, squad_phg, musique: NOT (lost > gained and p < 0.05) for H2_PATCH1 vs SAFE
decision_rule.metaqa_required: hop-2 ALL-gold H2_PATCH1 vs SAFE: gained > lost and p < 0.01 on BOTH metaqa caches
decision_rule.magnitude_is_reported_not_thresholded: hop-2 points vs SAFE and vs L1; the fraction of section 14.1's MICRO_L3_H2 hop-2 gain over L1 recovered over SAFE ((PATCH - SAFE) / (H2_RRF - L1)); no numeric target
decision_rule.PASS: MECHANISM_CONFIRMED_ON_DEV_A (POSTHOC): the unit-of-selection change works; promotion still requires an untouched population
decision_rule.FAIL: the patch does not convert the beam's discoveries under matched exposure, or is not text-safe; reported with the attribution below
